thread:
samir: quick repro: starterkit crashes in jsonMode when fn-calling and an auth refresh happens mid-request. sharing a tiny capture.
aj: paste the capture?
samir: network payload shows arguments serialized as a quoted string after retry:
```
{"type":"function_call","name":"create_invoice","arguments":"{\"amount\":100,\"currency\":\"USD\"}"}
```
samir: this makes the schema validator blow up.
maria: sounds like retry path re-runs JSON.stringify or a scrubber ran on the serialized body causing coercion. Seen parity gap: py avoids because it sends bytes.
jen: can reproduce locally by forcing 401+auto-refresh.
aj: hypothesis: retry middleware stringifies for metrics, transport stringifies again on resend -> double-encoded. sometimes scrubber coerces numbers to strings if it runs on serialized text.
kevin: temporary workaround for customers: pin token refresh in starter flow or opt out of jsonMode until patch.
aj: I'll open a small PR to make transport idempotent (skip stringify when body is already string/flagged) and add an integration test forcing auth-refresh to assert outgoing shape.
maria: also propose validator.lenient flag for starterkits to coerce harmless types during onboarding; not for prod.
jen: DX win: if jsonMode+fncall sees quoted arguments, surface a clear error suggesting retry/double-serialize instead of generic parse fail.

kevin: assigning aj -> PR/tests, devex -> README blurb, infra -> parity audit. keep thread open until PR lands.
